task: Create industrial infrastructure props and place them believably throughout the bunker: electrical runs (conduits, junction boxes), pipes with valves and supports, ventilation ducts, drainage elements, machinery components, service panels, brackets/supports, emergency equipment, storage systems. Ensure all infrastructure appears connected and purposeful - not randomly scattered. Place items in functionally appropriate locations (e.g., pipes along walls, electrical conduits following structural members, machinery in utility areas).
